item.title: WA's short-stay rules now carry real penalties
item.description: WA's first short-stay infringement arrived in August. From registration numbers to planning approvals and renewals, here are five developments worth checking before Perth's summer booking season.

item.title: Register first, list second: your WA compliance guide
item.description: Western Australia now fines hosts who get the basics wrong. This is the full, practical guide to being legal today: who registers, what it costs, where your number goes, how the 90-night exemption really works, and what ends a registration.

item.title: What 5,438 recently reviewed Perth listings reveal
item.description: A Western Host analysis of public Airbnb listing data for the 30 Perth metropolitan councils: how many listings were recently reviewed, how many are whole homes, what they ask per night, and where they are.

item.title: Platforms now report your short-stay income to the ATO
item.description: Since July 2023, booking platforms have given the ATO regular information about short-stay transactions. Here is what owners must declare, what may be deductible, what changed for holiday homes in 2026, and why records matter.

item.title: A 25-point check before Perth's peak season
item.description: Perth's busiest short-stay months run from December to February, on hot days, full pools and a live bushfire season. This one-page audit sorts the legal requirements from good practice, with the WA source for each.

item.title: Airbnb restricts checkout chores: what hosts need to know
item.description: For bookings made from 20 November 2026, Airbnb's new policy generally prohibits demanding substantial checkout chores, including stripping beds and washing dishes. Here is what remains acceptable and how hosts can prepare.

item.title: What it costs to dress one queen bed
item.description: For Perth and WA hosts: we priced one queen bedroom's sheets, quilt, pillows, protector, towels and amenities from supplier product pages on 17 November 2026. Here is what each set-up costs, how GST changes the sums, and who delivers.

item.title: Perth's summer dates worth planning around
item.description: From Boxing Day cricket to school holidays and the opening of Fringe World, Perth's summer calendar brings dates worth watching. Here is what to check when planning rates, staffing and guest arrivals.

item.title: Renting, granny flats and the 90-night rule
item.description:
Three common short-stay registration questions, answered using the WA Government's official guidance. This month: operating from a rental, counting the Perth 90-night exemption, and registering a granny flat.
_These questions are adapted from topics in the WA STRA Register's official FAQ; they are not submissions from individual readers. Send us yours for next month._

item.title: The missing number behind WA's first fine
item.description: In August, Consumer Protection announced its first A$2,000 infringement under WA's short-stay laws. The allegation concerned a missing registration number. We look at what the public record confirms, what it does not, and the checks every advertiser can make.
